root_cause.text: The driver fails to cancel the scheduled workqueue (`st->touch_st.workq`) before freeing the `indio_dev` device in the `at91_adc_remove()` function, allowing a concurrent work handler to use the freed device.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly describes the race where the work handler (`at91_adc_workq_handler`) can run after `iio_device_unregister(indio_dev)` has been called but before `indio_dev` is freed, leading to use-after-free. The fix adds `cancel_work_sync(&st->touch_st.workq)` to synchronize cancellation with the remove path.
